description: This file defines a Telemetry class for handling anonymous usage data collection in Next.js, including configuration management, hashing, and data posting.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: A class managing telemetry data collection, hashing, and transmission for Next.js.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes telemetry with configuration, session ID, and project ID.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies the user about telemetry collection if not already notified.

methods.name: anonymousId
methods.description: Getter that retrieves or generates a persistent anonymous ID.

methods.name: salt
methods.description: Getter that retrieves or generates a cryptographic salt for hashing.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if telemetry is disabled based on environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if telemetry collection is enabled.

methods.name: oneWayHash
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the payload combined with salt.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records telemetry events, returning a promise.

methods.name: submitRecord
methods.description: Submits telemetry data to the server.
